about: What a GitHub Actions runner account on the VPS should and should not reach. scripts/vps/Check-RunnerIsolation.ps1 compares Get-RunnerFacts.ps1 output, the workflows and the repository's Actions settings against it. Issue #2161. No secret belongs here.
decision: Patrick, 11 Oct 2026: pull request builds run on GitHub-hosted runners, never on productionLabel; pushes to main, nightly, release and Ship stay on the VPS. Owner of the build.yml move: Codex lane. docs/RUNNER-ISOLATION.md section 6.
